x: Eric Hall walked an excellent race in the 2 miles to finish 2nd to R, Goodall in 15 mins. with Ted Smith 3rd in 15.18. George Beecham 8th and H.McGreechan 10th were our scorers in the 5 miles, George Oliver 10th in the 4 miles and R, Newson 6th and L.

At Croydon Norman Guilmant was 4thm George Beecham, very fit after his holiday 5th, Hugh McGreechan 7th, Harry Shields 20th and Bernard 23rd, with Fred Rolfe, Bert Stallardm Ron Fairman, Joe Wilson and George Oliver coming along behind.
Russell (570yds) in 14m.31s. and he promises to augment our team strength in a very short while. 2nd and 3rd were Joe Coleman (440 yds) and George Oliver (320 yds).
In the early stages, Jack Bidgood Bert Clayton, Jack Baker, Jack Wakeley and George Oliver, walked in a group with Don Heath and Joe Wilson not far away.
